title: Stripe is reportedly in talks to buy PayPal - Engadget
summary: In an earlier report about the offer the buyers made, Reuters said Stripe and Advent would each hold an equal stake and would become PayPal's joint owners. Reuters said it would be processing around $3.7 trillion in payments a year.
